package.name: pepin_base_cpp
package.description: C++ base bridge: the board's base server (wheel odometry out, twists in) as /odom, the odom->base_link transform and a /cmd_vel sink. Same wire protocol, parameters and behaviour as pepin_bringup's Python base_bridge, at a tenth of its memory — the board is a 1.5 GB Orange Pi Zero 3 and every rclpy process costs ~190 MB there.
